definitions: Usable post-first completion tokens divided by summed request speculative rounds; summed request decode seconds divided by those same rounds. Their quotient is exactly native request-weighted decode TPS.
limits: An algebraic counter decomposition, not a new benchmark or physical GPU group-round measurement. C4 request intervals overlap and can include peer prefill or scheduling stalls; it cannot uniquely attribute changes to kernels, arrivals, acceptance or numeric differences. Full captured round timing is available separately in P0.
